name: Mushroom Risotto
instructions: Fry the mushrooms in half the butter and the oil over high heat until deeply browned, then set aside.
Lower the heat, soften the onion and garlic in the pan for 8 minutes.
Stir in the rice and toast for 2 minutes until the grains look translucent at the edges.
Pour in the wine and let it evaporate, then add the hot stock a ladle at a time, stirring.
After about 18 minutes the rice should be creamy but still firm in the centre.
Beat in the remaining butter, the parmesan, thyme and mushrooms off the heat.
Season, cover for 2 minutes to rest, then scatter with parsley and serve.
